gloss: to glare at each other; to be at odds

definitions.explanation: For two people or animals to stare hard at each other with hostility, as before a fight.

definitions.gloss: to be at odds; to face off
definitions.explanation: For two sides to confront each other in a tense standoff without either giving way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}った。
examples.english: The two glared at each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二匹|にひき}{睨|にら}み{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Two cats are glaring at each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦リング→リング：28765_ringu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{無言|むごん}→無言：13384_mugon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}い、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{静|しず}まり{返|かえ}った→静まり返る：14630_shizumarikaeru⟧。
examples.english: The fighters glared at each other in silence in the ring, and the hall went quiet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{両国|りょうこく}→両国：10010_ryoukoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The two countries are at odds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{与党|よとう}→与党：05241_yotou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{野党|やとう}→野党：02438_yatou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: The standoff between the ruling and opposition parties continues.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国境|こっきょう}→国境：02762_kokkyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{挟|はさ}んで→挟む：00091_hasamu⟧⟦{両軍|りょうぐん}→両軍：32009_ryougun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}ったまま、⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧。
examples.english: A week passed with the two armies facing off across the border.

notes:
⟦{睨|にら}む→睨む：02136_niramu⟧ (to glare) + ⟦{合|あ}う→合う：10466_au⟧ (each other). The noun {睨|にら}み{合|あ}い (a standoff) is as common as the verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- A⟦と→と：00512_to⟧B⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{睨|にら}み{合|あ}う: A and B glare at each other
- {睨|にら}み{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: the standoff continues
- {睨|にら}み{合|あ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up in a standoff

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対立|たいりつ}する→対立する：22172_tairitsusuru⟧: to be in conflict; neutral and abstract, without the image of two sides staring each other down
